description: Molecular docking was performed with MolecularDocking.online (https://moleculardocking.online/), a free web application that executes AutoDock Vina in the browser without local software installation. Receptor and ligand structures are uploaded, the search box is configured, and binding poses and scores are retrieved online. This entry documents that Methods step. The attached note is shared under CC-BY-4.0; the live web application remains subject to its own terms.
name: MolecularDocking.online browser AutoDock Vina
